stories.title: SAMPLE: Global markets react to central bank rate decision, indexes mixed
stories.summary: Equities wavered after the central bank held rates steady while signaling future tightening. Analysts see volatility persisting through the quarter.

stories.title: SAMPLE: World leaders gather for climate summit as targets come under scrutiny
